en: The thirtieth bead is gold on a board with five rows of six beads.
ja: 六個ずつ五段に並ぶ三十個の玉のうち、三十番目だけが金色になっている。
prompt:
Subject thirtieth. Counting board ONLY, front facing rectangular board. EXACTLY FIVE horizontal rows, SIX large separate beads in EACH row. Row one SIX RED. Row two SIX RED. Row three SIX RED. Row four SIX RED. Row five FIVE RED followed by ONE GOLD as last bead bottom right. Total exactly THIRTY beads, 29 red and 1 gold. All FIVE rows fully visible. NO people, no extra circles, no text or numbers.
Use attached invidious.png for drawing style only: thick rounded dark brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D forms. Exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands per person, normal compact forearm proportions. Clean smooth solid colors and restrained flat shadows. No watercolor grain, muddiness, speckles, mottling, paper texture, bleed or fuzzy edges. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows. All silhouettes clean closed dark brown outlines. 512x512 PNG RGBA. No text.
